rule: docs/design/src/007-tooling.md: Existing tools work; a require costs one lookup per tsconfig extends reference, not a re-entrant walk
reason: The opencode migration: packages/core/tsconfig.json extends "@tsconfig/bun/tsconfig.json"; under the vibelang/bun preload one require("fs") made 2,459 nested hook calls (210 ms), which made AppProcess's 250 ms child timeout fire before the child's SIGTERM handler, and a TUI plugin test's child took 22 s instead of 0.5 s.
